name: Tidy Event
author: tidyplugins

sections.description:
Tidy Event is a focused, no-bloat event manager. It registers an events custom post type with start/end dates, location and address, and ships blocks to display upcoming, past and mini-calendar views. Every event can be exported as an .ics file or added to Google Calendar in one click, and search engines get clean schema.org Event markup.

Features:

  • Events custom post type with start/end dates, place and address
  • 4 Gutenberg blocks: mini-calendar, event list, upcoming events, past events
  • Matching shortcodes for classic themes
  • Per-event .ics download and “Add to Google Calendar” links
  • schema.org/Event structured data for SEO
  • Event category taxonomy with colour coding
  • Block patterns for quick page building
  • Events included in the XML sitemap
  • Dashboard widget with the next upcoming events

Tidy Event Pro

The companion Tidy Event Pro plugin adds:

  • Month-grid calendar block
  • Document library block and custom post type (paginated PDF listing with category filters)
  • Location map on single events (address geocoding)
  • Photo gallery per event
  • Recurring events (weekly / monthly occurrences)
  • A subscribable site-wide ICS feed

More from Tidy Plugins

If you like this plugin, take a look at the rest of the Tidy suite:

  • Tidy Table of Contents — automatic, accessible table of contents
  • Tidy Related Posts — related posts with internal link audit
  • Tidy Draft Share — share drafts via secure, expiring preview links
  • Tidy Author Box — author bio box with avatar and social links

External services

This plugin can display an “Add to Google Calendar” link on each event. Nothing is sent automatically: the link points to Google Calendar (calendar.google.com) and only when a visitor clicks it, their browser opens Google Calendar with the event title, start and end dates, a short excerpt of the description and the location prefilled in the URL. No data is sent by your server. The link can be disabled in Settings > Tidy Event.

This service is provided by Google: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/tidy-event/
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu
  3. Add events from the new “Events” menu
  4. Insert an event block on any page, or go to Settings > Tidy Event to configure defaults
sections.faq:
Can visitors add an event to their own calendar?

Yes. Each event page offers a .ics download and an “Add to Google Calendar” link. Both buttons can be toggled from Settings > Tidy Event.

Does it work with classic (non-block) themes?

Yes. Every block has a matching shortcode: tidy_event_mini, tidy_event_upcoming, tidy_event_list and tidy_event_archive.

Do events appear in search results with rich data?

Yes. Single events output schema.org/Event JSON-LD, so search engines can display dates and locations.

What does the Pro version add?

Tidy Event Pro adds a month-grid calendar block, a document library, a location map, photo galleries, recurring events and a subscribable ICS feed. See the Description above.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • The “Attached PDF documents” box on the event screen is now translatable, like the rest of the interface.

1.1.1

  • The dashboard widget stylesheet is now loaded as a regular file on the Dashboard only.
  • Calendar downloads (.ics) now show apostrophes and line breaks correctly in calendar apps.

1.1.0

  • The plugin interface is now in English, with a complete French translation shipped alongside it. Previously every label was hardcoded in French, which made the plugin unusable in any other language.
  • Dates and times now follow the formats configured in WordPress instead of a fixed French format.
  • Event and category URL slugs are now in English (/event/, /events/). Existing sites keeping the old URLs can restore them with the tidy_event_single_slug and tidy_event_archive_slug filters.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
